quarterly_data.signal: Healthcare data: Mitsui entered a service agreement with Oncoshot Pte. Ltd. (Singapore) to use its AI-powered federated platform that anonymizes and structures oncology clinical data inside hospitals; with Memorial Sloan Kettering's MSK iHub, it aims to standardize oncology real-world data and promote international collaborative research, with oncology specialists of the IHH Healthcare network (Mitsui is IHH's largest shareholder; 89 hospitals across 10 countries) and elsewhere in Asia-Pacific. Yoichiro Endo (COO, Wellness Business Unit): Mitsui aims to expand data collaboration among IHH and leading medical institutions in Japan and Asia-Pacific and to develop new business opportunities in the United States and other markets.
